text:
alice: Heads up — we're scheduled to bring up AP‑SOUTHEAST‑2 cluster next Tue–Thu. Need to lock GPU quota + capacity reservation for the initial canary + staging fleet. Target: 20 H100 GPUs for prod canaries and 40 A100 GPUs for staging.

ben: Which cloud/provider and instance families are we targeting?

alice: AWS (ap-southeast-2). Planning p5.24xlarge for H100s and p4d.24xlarge for A100 workloads. Prefer Capacity Reservations in a single AZ to guarantee nodes during bootstrap.

carla: Ok. Two parallel asks: 1) Formal quota increase request to AWS support/account team for EC2 GPU quotas (regional) 2) Create Capacity Reservations (CR) in target AZ for the initial headroom.

carla: Ticket template (paste into support):
```
Subject: Request for regional EC2 GPU quota increase and capacity reservation (ap-southeast-2)
Body:
- Account ID: 123456789012
- Request: Increase On‑Demand instance quota for p5.24xlarge to 8 and p4d.24xlarge to 10 in ap-southeast-2 (region-level limit).
- Business justification: Production canary and staging needed to validate model serving runtime for Redwood Private customers. Start date: 2026-03-24. Duration: initial 30 days.
- Contact: alice@redwood.ai, infra escalation: carla@redwood.ai
```

dave: Add expected vCPU and ENI usage in the ticket — AWS often denies GPU requests without network/resource numbers. Also call our TAM and slack the account rep.

carla: Good call. Quick numbers: p5.24xlarge has 96 vCPUs, p4d.24xlarge has 96 vCPUs. If we request 8 p5 + 10 p4d, that's 1728 vCPUs. Add that to the ticket under "vCPU and ENI delta."

infra-bot: Reminder — internal quota process: <https://internal.redwood/docs/infra/quota-process> includes a signed cost approval and spend forecast step. Allocate cost center: infra-prod-03.

elaine: Cost estimate (on‑demand): p5.24xlarge ~ $60/hr, p4d.24xlarge ~ $40/hr. For planning assume peak of 18 H100s and 36 A100s = ~ (18*$60 + 36*$40) = $1,080 + $1,440 = $2,520/hr. Add 20% buffer for spot fallback testing.

ben: For Capacity Reservation we should create CRs per AZ with instancePlatform set and tenancy default. Example CLI for one CR:
```
aws ec2 create-capacity-reservation --instance-type p5.24xlarge --instance-platform "Linux/UNIX" --availability-zone ap-southeast-2a --instance-count 4 --tenancy default --tag-specifications 'ResourceType=capacity-reservation,Tags=[{Key=env,Value=canary}]'
```

ben: Note: CRs are billed when the instances are used, but you pay for reserved capacity if you create a Zonal CR without matching instances — include that in cost approval.

carla: For cross-checking, we should also open a ticket with the Marketplace/Account team to pre-warm underlying Nitro limits. I've pasted the internal request snippet in #infra-tickets.

alice: Hand-off plan: I will own creating the AWS support ticket and CR creation once quota is approved. Carla will own contacting the TAM and cost approval. Ben will run the CR CLI and validate. Elaine will own the cost forecast doc and sign-off. Dave will validate ENI/vCPU numbers.

dave: Quick validation checklist for after CRs are created:
- Verify CR ID exists and state=active
- Launch one test instance from the CR AZ with same AMI and user-data
- Confirm SGs/NACLs allow control-plane access to infra nodes (22, 443, 8000)
- Run small perf smoke (docker run --rm rwd/inference-smoke:latest)

carla: If quota is delayed, fallback plan: 1) Reduce initial H100 target to 10 and shift the rest to dedicated Reserved Instances later OR 2) Use cross-region fallback to ap-southeast-1 for ramp. Document fallback in the ticket.

alice: I'll file the ticket now with the template + vCPU numbers and tag you all. Expected AWS SR number in 2–8 business hours if TAM is involved.

infra-bot: Deploybot detected: scheduled deploy to infra-testing at 1769123600 — avoid heavy infra ops during 1769123500–1769123800.

ben: After SR approval I'll run the CR create and paste commands + IDs here. Remember to include --ebs-optimized and use the same placement group if we want low-latency NVLink tests.

elaine: Approved cost center on my side, sending sign-off to carla now.

alice: Thanks — will update thread when SR # arrives and when CRs are created. :thumbsup:

carla: LGTM. Keep the messages short in the support ticket and include the biz impact line — that's what speeds approvals.

alice: noted. Thanks everyone.
